paper.title: Efficient Transfer Learning via Causal Bounds

settings.name_in_paper: Transfer learning for MAB with valid causal bounds
unmapped: learner is given valid causal bounds l(a) <= mu_a <= h(a) for every arm, derived from offline confounded data
instance class restricted to MAB instances consistent with the causal bounds
settings.definition_quote: The MAB target agent aims to learn the causal effect of $A$ on $Y$, i.e., $\mu_a \triangleq \mean{Y|\mathrm{do}(A=a)}$ ... we assume that for each arm $a\in\mathcal{A}$ we have valid bounds $\mu_a \in [\widehat{l}(a), \widehat{h}(a)]$.

settings.name_in_paper: Transfer learning for MAB with valid causal bounds (lower bound)
unmapped: learner knows valid causal bounds [l(a), h(a)] containing each arm mean; sup taken over instances consistent with these bounds
settings.definition_quote: $\mathfrak{M} = \{ \text{MAB instances with } Y\in[0,1], \; l(a) \leq \mu_{a} \leq h(a), \forall a\in\mathcal{A} \}$.

settings.name_in_paper: Transfer learning for MAB with noisy causal bounds
unmapped: learner receives noisy causal bound estimates hat l(a), hat h(a) with known error radius eps_a(delta) holding w.p. 1-delta (Assumption 6)
settings.definition_quote: There exists a nonnegative function $\epsilon_a(\delta)$ such that the estimated causal bounds $\widehat l(a)$ and $\widehat h(a)$ satisfies $\mathbb{P}(\forall a: |\widehat h(a)-h(a)|\le\epsilon_a(\delta) \text{ and } |\widehat l(a)-l(a)|\le\epsilon_a(\delta)) \ge 1-\delta$.

settings.name_in_paper: Transfer learning for partially observable contextual bandits with function approximation
unmapped: realizable finite function class F of mean-reward functions (Assumption 7)
learner knows causal bounds l(a,w) <= f*(a,w) <= h(a,w), used to prune F and per-context action sets
settings.definition_quote: we assume the agent has access to a class of reward functions $\mathcal{F}\subset \mathcal{A}\times \mathcal{W} \to [0,1]$ ... There exists $f^*\in\mathcal{F}$ such that $f^*(a, w) = \mu_{a,w}$.

settings.name_in_paper: Causal bound estimation under parameter uncertainty
settings.out_of_scope_reason: Optimization/estimation of causal bounds over a relaxed density polytope; not a bandit problem.
unmapped: error of causal bounds computed over relaxed feasible set P^(N)_{eps_N}
settings.definition_quote: To account for estimation error, we replace the original feasible set $\mathcal{P}$ ... by the relaxed set $\mathcal{P}^{(N)}_{\epsilon_N}$

source.quote: Then the regret of \cref{alg: TL-MAB} is upper bounded by $\mean{ \mathrm{Reg}(T)} \leq \mathcal{O}(\sum_{a\in \widetilde{\mathcal{A}}^*:\Delta_a>0 } \log T / \Delta_a )$, where $\widetilde{\mathcal{A}}^* = \{ a \in\mathcal{A} \mid h(a) \ge \mu^* \}$.

results.notes: Consistency is presumably relative to the causal-bound-constrained class.

source.label: thm:minimax_LB_MAB_with_causal_bounds
source.quote: Suppose that $h(a)-l(a)=w$ for all arms $a\in\mathcal{A}^*$. Furthermore, there exist constants $\mu_0\in[0,1]$ and $\kappa \in (0,0.5)$ such that $ [\mu_0,\mu_0+\kappa w] \subset [l(a),h(a)]$ for all arms $a\in\mathcal{A}^*$. Then for any algorithm $\pi$, $\sup_{\mathfrak{M}} \mathbb{E}[\mathrm{Reg}(T)] \geq \Omega( \min\{ \sqrt{|\mathcal{A}^*| T},  wT \} )$.

source.label: thm: regret upper bound of MAB with noisy causal bounds
source.quote: The regret of \cref{alg: MAB with noisy causal bounds} satisfies $\mathbb{E}[\mathrm{Reg}(T)] =  \mathcal{O}(\sum_{a \in \widehat{\mathcal{A}}: \Delta_a > 0} ( \widehat{\sigma}_a^2 \log( T ) - H_a)_+ / \Delta_a)$.

results.notes: Choice of delta not stated in the theorem; algorithm does not take T as input, marked anytime. Hat A is random (depends on estimated bounds).

symbols.sum_hatA_all: sum over all arms in hat A
symbols.h_i: causal upper bound of arm i
symbols.l_i: causal lower bound of arm i
symbols.kappa_i: kappa_a(T) = (h(a)-l(a))(T + sum eps^{-2}) / sum (h-l) eps^{-2} = O(T)

source.label: thm: worst-case regret bound of MAB with noisy causal bounds
source.number: Theorem (thm: worst-case regret bound of MAB with noisy causal bounds)
source.quote: With probability at least $1 - \delta$, $\mathrm{Reg}(T)$ is upper bounded by $\mathcal{O}(\min\{\max_{a\in \widehat{\mathcal{A}}} \widehat{\sigma}_a \sqrt{ |\widehat{\mathcal{A}}|T \log(4|\widehat{\mathcal{A}}|T/ \delta)} , [T \sqrt{\frac{ \log(4|\widehat{\mathcal{A}}|T/\delta)}{\tau^*}} +  \sum_{a\in \widehat{\mathcal{A}}} \frac{h(a)-l(a)}{\epsilon^{2}_{a}(\delta) }  \log(\kappa_a(T) )]\})$

symbols.F_star: |F*|, size of causally pruned function class

source.label: thm: upper bound for TL with function approximation
source.quote: Consider a contextual bandit problem with $|\mathcal{A}|<\infty$ and $|\mathcal{F}|<\infty$ under \cref{asp: realizability}. With probability at least $1-\delta$, the expected regret of \cref{alg: TL-function approximation} is upper bounded by $\mean{\mathrm{Reg}(T)} \le \mathcal{O} (\sqrt{ \mathbb{E}_W[ \mathcal{A}^*(W) ] T  \log (\delta^{-1}|\mathcal{F}^*|\log T  ) } )$.

results.notes: Statement mixes 'with probability 1-delta' and 'expected regret'; regret is defined via conditional expectations of f* gaps. Recorded as high-probability. Remark 9 extends to infinite classes via covering numbers (+eps T).

symbols.F_star: |F*|, size of causally pruned function class

conditions: sup over instances consistent with causal bounds

source.label: thm: lower bound for TL with function approximation
source.quote: Then for any algorithm $\mathsf{A}$ with access to the function space $\mathcal{F}$, we have $\sup_{  \mathfrak{M}  }  \limsup_{T\to\infty}  \frac{  \mathrm{Reg}(T) }{ \sqrt{T}  } \geq  \sqrt{\mathbb{E}_W [ | {\mathcal{A}^*}(W)|  ] \log |\mathcal{F}^*| }$.

results.notes: Lower bound on limsup of Reg(T)/sqrt(T); expression multiplied by sqrt(T).

symbols.L_V: Lipschitz constant of causal quantity V in L2
symbols.L_H: Hausdorff-rate constant of relaxed feasible set

source.label: thm: difference of empirical bounds and true bounds
source.quote: Suppose that $|V(\rho_1) - V(\rho_2)| \leq L_V \|\rho_1 - \rho_2\|$ ... and $d_H( \cPeps{N}, \mathcal{P} ) \leq L_H \epsilon_N$, then $ |V_{\min}^{(N)} - V_{\min}| \leq L_VL_H \epsilon_N $ and $ |V_{\max}^{(N)} - V_{\max}| \leq L_VL_H \epsilon_N $.

results.notes: Deterministic error bound on causal-bound values (same for V_max); not a bandit result.
